summary: Challenge to High Court's modification reducing IPC s.325 sentence from 5 to 4 years with conditional suspension on deposit of Rs 5 lakh compensation; validity of substituting sentence reduction with compensation under CrPC s.357; distinction between fine-based compensation and substantive sentence; reliance on Ankush Shivaji Gaikwad (2013) SCC scrutinized; Court finds High Court conflated compensation order with sentence execution.
legal_provisions_cited: Maru Ram vs Union of India (1981)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's conditional suspension of sentence set aside; respondents to serve reduced 4-year sentence without compensation substitution.
